summary: When adding a network platform or changing its connections, update the settings_by_platform table and add or modify the platform options file, in addition to module docs.
questions: What docs do I need to update for a new network platform?

answer_card.title: Docs for a new network platform
answer_card.answer_md: Besides documenting each module, update the `settings_by_platform` table and add or update your platform's Platform Options file.
